name: Lost Heaven Roleplay
loginDescription: The streets remember. Pick up where you left off.
registerDescription: A new name. A fresh start. A place in Lost Heaven.
passwordHint: 10–128 characters. Make it yours to keep.
rememberMe: Sign me in automatically on this device
spawningDescription: Your character is ready. Waiting for the city to finish loading.
returningDescription: Your place is waiting, right where you left it.
savedNote: Your place in the city is saved when you leave.
randomNote: Your first character is chosen for you. Your story is yours.
previewNote: Sign in inside the game to enter Lost Heaven.

errors.invalidUsername: Use 3–24 letters, numbers or underscores for your username.
errors.invalidCredentials: That username and password do not match.
errors.rememberedExpired: Your saved sign-in has expired. Enter your password again.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is already registered. Choose another or sign in.
errors.alreadyOnline: This account is already in the city. Disconnect the other session first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: The city registry is unavailable. Please try again.
errors.notReady: The city is still loading. You will enter as soon as it is ready.
errors.timeout: The city did not answer. Please try again.
errors.banned: This account is banned. Contact an administrator.

recorder.title: Camera recorder
recorder.movement: WASD move · Q / E down / up · Shift faster · Alt slower
recorder.look: Arrow keys or right-drag to look · Space + mouse left / right to roll · Backspace removes the last point · This camera can pass through walls.

status.ready: Frame your first shot, then press F2.
status.pointAdded: Camera position and viewing direction recorded.
status.newSpline: Previous spline kept. Ready to record a new shot.
status.needPoints: Record at least two points in each spline first.
status.saved: Paths saved. They will play on the next connection.
status.saveFailed: Could not save the paths. Try again.

admin.denied: Your rank does not allow this command.
admin.playerMissing: Player {player} is not connected. Use their username or #player ID.
admin.spawnRequired: Both players must be alive and in the city.
admin.failed: The command could not be completed.
admin.cooldown: Wait a moment before spawning another car.
admin.weaponUsage: Usage: /weapon <weapon ID> [ammo] [player]. Use /weapons to list IDs.
admin.helpUser: /players lists players. /logout forgets this device and returns to login. /houses, /interiors.
admin.positionUnavailable: Could not capture the current position. Stay on foot or in the same vehicle and try /savepos again.

properties.failed: Could not save the change. Check the server log.
properties.help: Houses: /house_buy [id], /house_lock [id], /house_unlock [id], /garage_save [house] [slot], /leave. Enter near an arrow to use it.
properties.interiorHelp: /interior_exit <name> records an interior and exit. /interior_entry <name> adds a public entrance. /interior_go <name> previews it. /interior_remove <entrance id> removes an entrance.
properties.nearHouse: Stand on foot beside a house entrance.
properties.unfinished: This house has no interior assigned yet.
properties.bought: You bought house #{id} for ${price}. It is locked; you can enter now.
properties.owned: This house already has an owner.
properties.funds: You need ${price} to buy this house.
properties.ownerRequired: Use your own house entrance or parking slot.
properties.garageHelp: Stop in your parking slot as the driver, with no passengers. Use /garage_save [house] [slot] to replace its saved car.
properties.missing: House, entrance or interior not found. Use /interiors for editor help.
properties.setHelp: Usage: /house_set <house id> <price in dollars> <interior name>. Record the interior first with /interior_exit.
properties.occupied: This interior or saved vehicle is occupied. Wait until it is empty.
properties.garageRecordHelp: Stop in a vehicle as its driver, in the public world. /house_garage [house id] adds a slot to your last recorded or selected house.
properties.garageRecorded: House #{id}: parking slot {slot} recorded with vehicle position and rotation.
properties.onFoot: Leave your vehicle before using an interior.
properties.entryHelp: /house_entry creates a house at your position. /house_entry <house id> adds another entrance. Stand in the public world.
properties.entryRecorded: House #{id}: entrance recorded. Attach parking with /house_garage; assign price and interior with /house_set.
properties.interiorRecorded: Interior {name}: arrival position and exit arrow recorded.
properties.buyHelp: House #{id} costs ${price}. Use /house_buy {id} to purchase it.
properties.alreadySaved: This car is already assigned to a different parking slot.
properties.waitForCar: Vehicle condition is still synchronizing. Wait a moment, then save again.
properties.carSaved: Car saved to house #{id}, slot {slot}. It will return here in this condition after loss or a server restart.
